summary: Discover the power of data in combating climate change. Enroll in our course on Data Analytics for Environmental Conservation and make a difference today.
lede: Environmental data analysis helps climate and conservation teams turn emissions, climate, geospatial, and biodiversity datasets into decision-ready evidence. For professionals using spreadsheets or operational data, the course covers data-quality checks, emissions indicators, climate-risk assessment, spatial mapping, and biodiversity monitoring, with practice communicating results through dashboards and reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who use climate, emissions, geospatial, or biodiversity evidence to plan action, monitor change, and report environmental performance. It supports foundation-to-intermediate learners who can work with spreadsheets or operational datasets and want a structured analytical workflow.
prerequisites: You need basic spreadsheet literacy and a working interest in climate change, environmental conservation, sustainability reporting, or ecological monitoring. The course uses practical datasets and guided exercises, so coding is not required for completion. Advanced topics such as Google Earth Engine workflows and AI-assisted image classification remain at an operational awareness level, while emissions calculations, data-quality checks, QGIS mapping, and indicator design receive hands-on practice.
